title: Q-WORKERS-252: cross-repo stale branch sweep (migrated from workers#252)
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** daily lane pass
**Done check:** grep:ops/branchsweep-ledger.jsonl::ultrastable/workers
**Status:** closed

Migrated from ultrastable/workers#252 (closed with this disposition). foundation/branchsweep.py works on the local checkout, so stale claude/* and agent/* branches in workers, ops and practical-solutions are never pruned. Add a cross-repo pass over a fleet list in doctrine/branchsweep.json that deletes branches whose PR is merged/closed or whose head is an ancestor of the default branch, one ledger row each; unmerged work becomes a PORT-BRANCH item.

size: M

**Closing probe:** grep:ops/branchsweep-ledger.jsonl::ultrastable/workers

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 57.9 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
